name: MP1584EN mini adjustable buck module
description: Tiny step-down converter (22 x 17 mm), 4.5-28 V in, adjustable out (default 5 V), about 1.5-2 A continuous.
notes: The output voltage is set by a trim pot and arrives set to a random value (often the maximum). Power it with nothing connected, measure OUT+ with a multimeter, turn the pot to the target, then connect the load.
IN- and OUT- are the same ground (non-isolated).
No reverse-polarity protection: swapping IN+ and IN- destroys it instantly.
MP1584 chip: 4.5-28 V input, 3 A peak. The tiny module overheats above about 1.5-2 A continuous; this entry uses 1.8 A.
Absolute maximum input is 30 V: do not use on a 24 V supply that can spike, or on 7S+ batteries.
Pad positions vary between sellers; labels are printed on the bottom side of many boards.
